interface.name: cutefish_window_placement_v1

description.summary: windows that place themselves on the screen

interface.description: Lets a client put its normal windows at positions of its own choosing and learn where they are, in the compositor's global logical coordinates, where xdg_output places each output. Positions are those of the top left corner of the window geometry. The compositor offers this global only to clients it trusts to place their windows; others never see it. A client may name only its own surfaces.

request.name: set_position

description.summary: put a window at a position

request.description: A surface that is not yet a mapped toplevel maps with its window geometry's top left at the position, the next time it maps, in place of the compositor's own placement and of set_restore_id; a placement anchor of cutefish_window_hints_v1 takes precedence. A mapped normal window moves there at once. Either way the compositor keeps enough of the window on an output to grab it again. Maximized, fullscreen and tiled windows, and windows the user is dragging, ignore it.

event.name: position
event.description: The top left of the window geometry of one of the client's mapped toplevels: sent when it maps and each time it moves afterwards, whoever moved it.
